title: damm32-table — case shape (v0.1)
description: Pins the frozen Damm-32 order-32 quasigroup table (account-number.md §4.2) for cross-implementation byte-identity, plus running-checksum orientation cases. The table is derived over GF(2⁵) ≅ GF(2)[x]/(x⁵+x²+1) with the operation x∗y = α·(x⊕y) (α the field element 2; reduction bitmask 0b100101 = 37) over Crockford-base32 indices. The literal table is the normative artifact; the construction is informative. Two case kinds: 'table' (the full 1024-byte table as row-major hex, table[interim][symbol]), 'checksum' (running-checksum over a sequence of entropy indices, pinning direction/orientation). Reference: protocol/src/account_number.rs (damm32_table / damm32_step); decisions.md 2026-04-28 polynomial-form freeze + the table-freeze follow-on.

vector_id.description: Stable identifier of the form 'damm32-table/v0.1/<descriptive-slug>'. Immutable once shipped.

oneOf.title: table — pin the full 1024-byte quasigroup table

expected_table_hex.description: The full 32×32 = 1024-byte table, row-major: byte at offset (32*interim + symbol) is table[interim][symbol]. Each byte is a Crockford-base32 index 0..31. A port derives its own order-32 quasigroup over GF(2⁵) and asserts byte-equality against this value.

informational_polynomial.description: The GF(2⁵) reduction polynomial, e.g. 'x^5 + x^2 + 1 (0b100101 = 37)'. Informational — the table is the contract.

informational_alphabet.description: The Crockford-base32 alphabet whose positions are the 0..31 indices, e.g. '0123456789ABCDEFGHJKMNPQRSTVWXYZ'. The table is alphabet-independent at the index level; this records which glyph order maps to which index in Myne. Informational.

informational_provenance.description: Provenance note for the table (e.g. 'matches published srobo/damm32 reference (MIT)'). Provenance/citability only — not an independent-correctness claim. Informational.

input_entropy_indices.description: Sequence of 0..31 Crockford indices, processed left-to-right from interim 0: interim := table[interim][index]. Pins the running-checksum direction (left fold) and orientation (row = interim, column = symbol).

expected_check_index.description: The final interim after folding all input_entropy_indices from 0 — i.e. the Damm-32 check index. A port computes its fold and asserts equality.

informational_note.description: Human-readable note on what the case demonstrates. Informational — runners do not consume it.
